name: home
desc: Idle / default home. Hosts all home gestures. Hidden unread badge (UI_EVT_NOTIFICATION).

name: wakeup
desc: Wakeup: eyes open (runtime frame sequence). Hand-over to listening is event-driven (tap = demo).

name: listening
desc: Listening: focused face + volume waveform (bars resized/opacity by audio level).

name: thinking
desc: Thinking: face + 3 pulsing cyan dots on the forehead.

name: speaking
desc: Speaking: mouth frames follow TTS (runtime); tap = interrupt.

name: asr_failed
desc: ASR failed: confused face + 没听清; tap = retry.

name: llm_error
desc: LLM request failed: confused face + 暂时无法回答; tap = retry.

name: tts_error
desc: TTS playback failed: mouth stopped (sad frame) + 播放失败; tap = back to idle.

name: network_lost
desc: Network lost: worried face + 网络已断开.

name: reconnecting
desc: Reconnecting: expectant face + 重新连接中 prompt.

name: battery_low
desc: Low battery: tired face + 电量低 15% (reduce animation FPS in runtime).

name: face_happy
desc: Happy emotion frame. Tap = home; swipe right = character preview.

name: face_laugh
desc: Laugh emotion frame. Tap = home; swipe right = character preview.

name: face_excited
desc: Excited emotion frame. Tap = home; swipe right = character preview.

name: face_curious
desc: Curious emotion frame. Tap = home; swipe right = character preview.

name: face_surprised
desc: Surprised emotion frame. Tap = home; swipe right = character preview.

name: face_shy
desc: Shy emotion frame. Tap = home; swipe right = character preview.

name: face_sad
desc: Sad emotion frame. Tap = home; swipe right = character preview.

name: face_confused
desc: Confused emotion frame. Tap = home; swipe right = character preview.

name: face_angry
desc: Angry emotion frame. Tap = home; swipe right = character preview.

name: face_love
desc: Love emotion frame. Tap = home; swipe right = character preview.

name: face_sleepy
desc: Sleepy emotion frame. Tap = home; swipe right = character preview.

name: face_sleep
desc: Sleep emotion frame. Tap = home; swipe right = character preview.

name: face_confident
desc: Confident (board only) emotion frame. Tap = home; swipe right = character preview.

name: face_cried
desc: Cried (board only) emotion frame. Tap = home; swipe right = character preview.

name: time_weather
desc: Time, date, weather. Face stays small and un-covered. Swipe right = home.

name: notification
desc: Notification list: source, title, short body. Vertical scroll in runtime; swipe right = home.

name: quick_settings
desc: Quick settings: Wi-Fi/BT/DND toggles, brightness+volume -> system settings, sleep. Swipe up = home.

name: personality
desc: Personality: character, feedback strength, animation activity. Swipe left = home.

name: sleep_settings
desc: Sleep settings: auto-sleep timeout, wake method, sleep animation. Swipe right = personality.

name: system_settings
desc: System settings: brightness, volume, network, time sync. Swipe right = quick settings.

name: system_info
desc: Storage + version, entry points to dev/preview pages. Swipe right = system settings.

name: character_preview_1
desc: Character preview page 1/3: tap a thumbnail to open that expression. Swipe left/right = page.

name: character_preview_2
desc: Character preview page 2/3: tap a thumbnail to open that expression. Swipe left/right = page.

name: state_preview
desc: State preview page 3/3: jump to every voice/error state (they are event-driven on device). Swipe right = page 2.

name: expression_manager
desc: Expression resource list (name, frames, status). Missing resource shows the fallback state. Swipe right = system info.

name: animation_manager
desc: Animation resource list (frames, FPS, load state). Swipe right = system info.
